verdict.rationale: Elicit's core workflows operate on many papers simultaneously: Systematic Reviews gather, screen, and extract data across large paper sets (elicit-docs-22, elicit-docs-14), and Columns apply the same extraction instruction across an entire table of papers at once (elicit-docs-18, elicit-docs-11), enabling true bulk operations across many items. API access (elicit-docs-6) further supports programmatic bulk use for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of bulk-scale performance and accuracy, and no documented limits or benchmarks on how many items can be processed at once — community reports (elicit-comm-3, elicit-comm-4) raise accuracy concerns on individual extractions that temper confidence in quality at scale.
